'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Quest Exclusive NPC Gladiator who only appears during {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}.
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;Been a long while since the fire of the hunt burned this bright around here...
:;How I wish you  were here to see it with me, old friend...

:'''Corrado:''' A newcomer, are ya? Looking for someone to talk to?
:{{DIcon}} Any stories about the hunts you've joined?
:'''Corrado:''' Haha, sure. Let me tell you one... One I'll never forget.
:'''Corrado:''' Thirty years ago, I went hunting with [[Falco|an old friend]]. We were young, hungry for the biggest, meanest beast we could find. My friend was stronger than the rest of us, and twice as ambitious. 
:'''Corrado:''' Following his plan, we spent days luring a Tacet Discord into the beast's territory. The goal was to provoke its territorial instinct and drive it into a fight.
:'''Corrado:''' When the two monsters clashed, we pounced. With the help of the [[By Sun's Burning Hand#Glossary|Griffrexes]], we drove our blades through the beast's skull.
:{{DIcon}} And then? What happened next?
:'''Corrado:''' And then... he claimed the kill, took the glory, and left the [[Sanguis Plateaus|Plateaus]].
:'''Corrado:''' I didn't mind. That was always our agreement. We both had dreams, and he had the better shot at making them real.
:'''Corrado:''' But... like the beast we slew, he couldn't conquer his own hunger. Just another hunter, lost in someone else's hunting ground.
{{Dialogue End}}
